Routines

top source red::cameras

SST pipeline

red::cameras [, instrument=string] [, nb_cameras=string] [, nb_detectors=string] [, Nnbcams=integer], nbr_camera=nbr_camera, nbr_detector=nbr_detector [, Nnbrcams=integer], nbt_camera=nbt_camera, nbt_detector=nbt_detector [, Nnbtcams=integer] [, pd_camera=string] [, pd_detector=string] [, Npdcams=string] [, wb_camera=string] [, wb_detector=string] [, Nwbcams=string]

Identify cameras and detectors for WB, NB, PD, as well as the instrument.

Keywords

instrument out optional type=string

The name of the instrument, with first letter in caps, like Crisp.

nb_cameras out optional type=string

NB camera names.

nb_detectors out optional type=string

NB detector names.

Nnbcams out optional type=integer

Number of NB cameras.
